about: StoneRoadMap kit textures, Direction B (Métal Hurlant necro-cathedral), generated by grace for Patch on 2026-11-12 and in use since that day. Each surface owns one pigment family: dark slate floor, mid grey-violet ashlar wall, oxblood trim, near-black ceiling. Z-Image base bf16 with the house LoRA rrink_zimage_v5_seg6_3000 at 1.0, seamless, 25 steps res_multistep cfg 4 shift 3, 1024x1024, on den-m5 and den-nimo; normals by authoring/tools/textures/make_tileable.py at strength 3. Each entry names its seed; the other seeds and the concept references are in authoring/assets/textures/stoneroad-direction-b/ (its sources.json and README.md).

floor-slate-basalt.route: ComfyUI on den-m5: Z-Image base + LoRA rrink_zimage_v5_seg6_3000_steps_00001_.safetensors at 1.0, seamless
floor-slate-basalt.prompt: rrink style, hand-inked in the manner of Moebius (Jean Giraud), 1970s European ligne claire science-fiction illustration, clean ink linework with fine hatching and painted cel tones, flat top-down view of a worn dungeon floor of large interlocking cut basalt-slate stone slabs, uniform dark desaturated slate-indigo colour across every stone with no pink or multicoloured slabs, mostly calm flat cel-shaded stone faces with dark inked joints and fine hair cracks, filling the whole image, even flat lighting, no shadows
